summary_1line: Yudhishthira awakens to royal music, performs purification and worship rituals, donates lavish gifts to Brahmanas, and formally receives Krishna in court.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Yudhishthira bathes while a hundred white-clad attendants pour fragrant water from golden jars.
Yudhishthira presents golden coins, ornamented horses, and decorated cows to thousands of Vedic Brahmanas gathered in a great chamber.
Krishna enters the royal hall as Yudhishthira sits on a pearl‑studded golden throne while attendants wave white yak‑tail fans.
